Localization.Name: Vendetta "SteelTek" HMG
Localization.Description:
Manufacturer: Apocalypse Arms
Item Type: HMG
Class: Ballistic

Magazine Size: 1000
Rate Of Fire: 1000 rpm
Effective Range: 35 m

Attachments: N/A

Too large to use except with a heavy exo-suit, the Vendetta from Apocalypse Arms is a belt-fed instrument of death. What it lacks in accuracy it makes up for with a high rate of fire for complete target saturation and battlefield dominance.

The SteelTek edition features a shining metallic coating with a Damascus pattern that runs across the surface.
